description:
Currently all file tools (read/write/edit/ls/bash/grep/find)
accept any absolute path the model chooses. A model can reach
outside the session's working directory (~/.ssh/id_rsa,
/etc/passwd, etc.). Phase 3 deferred cwd threading; this ticket
lands it.

Design:
- Tool factory functions take `cwd` arg: `Read.tool(cwd)` → `%Tool{}`
  with a `prepare_arguments` closure that:
  - Canonicalizes paths via `Path.expand(p, cwd)`
  - Rejects paths that escape cwd via `..` after canonicalization
  - For bash: rejects `cwd` arg that escapes session cwd
- Print mode + RPC mode build the tool list with the session cwd
  already bound.
- Emit a clear error message when a tool call tries to escape:
  "path escapes session cwd: /etc/passwd"

Signatures change: `Tools.Read.tool()` → `Tools.Read.tool(cwd)`.
Callers (print.ex, cli.ex, agent.demo if it uses them) update.

TDD:
- tools accept paths relative to cwd
- absolute path within cwd works
- `..` escape rejected with error tool-result
- symlinks that resolve outside cwd rejected
- bash cwd arg outside session cwd rejected
title: Enforce session cwd rooting for tool paths
